articles.title: Trump signs executive order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
articles.highlight: 特朗普周四签署行政命令，指示联邦政府将安大略湖更名为“美国湖”，此举正值他与加拿大贸易战升级之际。
articles.summary: 文章报道了特朗普签署行政命令，试图将安大略湖更名为“美国湖”，以配合其对加拿大的贸易战。但该命令无权改变加拿大一侧的湖名，也无法强制国际机构或世界其他国家采用新名称。加拿大领导人和多名美国州长均表示反对，值得阅读以了解单方面改名行动的法律界限和政治象征意义。
articles.failureAnalysis: 核心启示：美国行政命令只能更改本国地图和文件中的名称，对加拿大主权、国际法律机构及全球约定俗成的地名使用没有约束力，因此该举动主要停留在政治象征层面。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Mark Carney rejects attempt to rename lake as did several US governors, with Tony Evers mocking the move US politics live – latest updates Donald Trump signed an executive order on Thursday directing the federal government to rename Lake Ontario, making it Lake America, amid his escalating trade war with Canada. The order directs federal agencies to adopt the name-change on US maps, documents and databases. But Trump has no authority to rename Canada’s portion of the lake, nor to compel Canada, international legal bodies, international mapmakers, or the rest of the world to adopt a new name.

articles.title: LibriBrain100: One Hundred Hours of Broad and Deep MEG Data for Neural Speech Decoding at Scale
articles.selectionReason: Open full-text paper; topic brain_computer_interface; quality signal passed; application scenario is clear.

paperCard.problem: 非侵入式语音解码缺乏大规模标准数据集和统一评估协议，难以衡量进展。
paperCard.method: 构建LibriBrain100数据集，包含约80小时单一被试深度MEG和32名被试各约40分钟的广度数据，提供标准划分、词分类基准和开源工具。
paperCard.difference: 相比原有LibriBrain只有单一被试和单一类型（侦探小说），LibriBrain100既加深了单被试数据（约80小时），又拓展了32名新被试，并加入TIMIT、MOCHA-TIMIT和播客等多样刺激，覆盖语音和语义。
paperCard.innovation: 深度优先同时兼顾广度，提供标准训练/验证/测试划分和公开基准，支持可复现评估；规模上创下单被试80小时新纪录。
paperCard.implementation: 使用MEGIN TRIUX Neo 306通道MEG系统采集，1kHz采样后降采样到250Hz；数据以原始和预处理格式发布，提供Python库支持下载、预处理和深度学习加载；使用MEG-XL模型作为基线。
paperCard.applications: 非侵入式脑机接口、恢复严重瘫痪患者沟通能力、语音解码、脑机接口竞赛基准。
technicalTerms: MEG：脑磁图，无创测量脑磁场活动
词分类：从脑信号中识别听到的单词
被试内/跨被试：同一个人的数据训练/不同人的数据训练

articles.highlight: LibriBrain100将单被试MEG数据扩展到约80小时，是同类数据集的8倍，为深度神经语音解码树立新纪录。
articles.summary: 论文介绍LibriBrain100，一个超过100小时的高质量MEG语音解码数据集，包括约80小时的单被试深度数据和32名被试各约40分钟的广度数据。它提供标准词分类基准和开源工具，用于推动非侵入式脑机接口研究。该数据集规模大、设计规范，对脑机接口社区有重要参考价值。
articles.failureAnalysis: 主要限制是80小时的单被试深数据在实际应用中难以复制，跨被试泛化仍需更多验证。
articles.sourceExcerpt: LibriBrain100: One Hundred Hours of Broad and Deep MEG Data for Neural Speech Decoding at Scale Francesco Mantegna1 Dulhan Jayalath1 Gereon Elvers1 Tasha Kim1 Benjamin Ballyk1 Alex Fung1,2 SungJun Cho1,3 Teyun Kwon1 Luisa Kurth1 Miran Özdogan1 Gilad Landau1 Pratik Somaiya1 Natalie Voets2 Mark Woolrich3 Oiwi Parker Jones1 1PNPL , Department of Engineering Science, University of Oxford, UK 2FMRIB, Oxford Centre for Integrative Neuroimaging, University of Oxford, UK 3OHBA, Oxford Centre for Integrative Neuroimaging, University of Oxford, UK {francesco, oiwi}@robots.ox.ac.uk Abstract We introduce LibriBrain100, a large-scale MEG dataset for speech decoding de- signed from the ground up for reproducible, standardised evaluation. LibriBrain100 more than doubles the size of the original LibriBrain release, resulting inover 100 hours of high-quality MEGacquired while subjects listened to naturalistic continuous speech. With ∼80 hours from a single subject, LibriBrain100 sets a new record for deep, within-subject neural data (8× more than the next comparable dataset and roughly 80 × more than other datasets).

paperCard.difference: 相比原有LibriBrain只有单一被试和单一类型（侦探小说），LibriBrain100既加深了单被试数据（约80小时），又拓展了32名新被试，并加入TIMIT、MOCHA-TIMIT和播客等多样刺激，覆盖语音和语义。
paperCard.innovation: 深度优先同时兼顾广度，提供标准训练/验证/测试划分和公开基准，支持可复现评估；规模上创下单被试80小时新纪录。
paperCard.implementation: 使用MEGIN TRIUX Neo 306通道MEG系统采集，1kHz采样后降采样到250Hz；数据以原始和预处理格式发布，提供Python库支持下载、预处理和深度学习加载；使用MEG-XL模型作为基线。
paperCard.applications: 非侵入式脑机接口、恢复严重瘫痪患者沟通能力、语音解码、脑机接口竞赛基准。
technicalTerms: MEG：脑磁图，无创测量脑磁场活动
词分类：从脑信号中识别听到的单词
被试内/跨被试：同一个人的数据训练/不同人的数据训练

en.highlight: With ~80 hours from a single subject, LibriBrain100 sets a new record for deep, within-subject neural data—8x more than the next comparable dataset.
en.summary: The paper introduces LibriBrain100, a 100+ hour high-quality MEG dataset for speech decoding, with ~80 hours from a single subject and ~40 minutes from each of 32 additional subjects. It provides standard word-classification benchmarks and open-source tools to advance non-invasive brain-computer interfaces. The dataset's scale and standardized design make it a valuable reference for the BCI community.
en.failureAnalysis: The main limitation is that 80 hours of per-subject deep data is impractical to replicate in real-world applications, and cross-subject generalization still needs further validation.
en.title: LibriBrain100: One Hundred Hours of Broad and Deep MEG Data for Neural Speech Decoding at Scale

paperCard.problem: Non-invasive speech decoding lacks large-scale standardized datasets and common evaluation protocols, making it hard to measure progress.
paperCard.method: Build LibriBrain100, containing ~80 hours of deep single-subject MEG and ~40 minutes from each of 32 subjects, with standard splits, a word-classification benchmark, and open-source tooling.
paperCard.difference: Unlike the original LibriBrain, which had only a single subject and one genre (detective fiction), LibriBrain100 deepens single-subject data to ~80 hours and broadens to 32 new subjects, adding diverse stimuli like TIMIT, MOCHA-TIMIT, and podcasts to cover phonetics and semantics.
paperCard.innovation: It prioritizes depth while adding breadth, providing standard train/validation/test splits and a public benchmark for reproducible evaluation; it sets a new record with ~80 hours from one subject.
paperCard.implementation: MEG data were collected on a MEGIN TRIUX Neo 306-channel system, sampled at 1 kHz then downsampled to 250 Hz. Raw and preprocessed data are released, with a Python library for downloading, preprocessing, and loading for deep learning; baselines use the MEG-XL model.
paperCard.applications: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, restoring communication for people with severe paralysis, speech decoding, and benchmarking for BCI competitions.
technicalTerms: MEG: Magnetoencephalography, a non-invasive way to measure brain magnetic fields
Word classification: Identifying spoken words from brain signals
Within-subject/cross-subject: Trained on data from the same person / trained on data from different people

articles.title: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: 本文报道了提示注入研究者Johann Rehberger对Claude Code自动模式的一次攻击，成功率高达80%。攻击通过诱导模型解压zip并执行恶意代码实现，而在部分运行中自动模式甚至阻止了模型尝试终止恶意进程的命令。作者强调，面对对抗性攻击，唯一安全的方式是在隔离沙箱中运行代理，并限制网络出口和敏感凭据。
articles.failureAnalysis: 核心教训是，不能只依赖模型自带的分类器作为安全边界，因为安全机制本身可能被绕过甚至反过来阻碍防御。实际部署时应将代理运行在容器或虚拟机中，并严格限制其网络访问和凭据暴露。
articles.highlight: 安全机制本身也可能成为故障的一部分：模型检测到了入侵，但自动模式却阻止了用于终止恶意进程的清理命令。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode Anthropic are putting a great deal of faith in Claude Code's auto mode for protecting their coding agent users against prompt injection attacks. They recently made that the default and have made bold claims about its effectiveness. Johann Rehberger is one of the most credible prompt injection researchers active today.

en.highlight: The safety mechanism itself can become part of the failure: Claude detects the compromise, but auto mode blocks its cleanup command.
en.summary: This article reports on prompt injection researcher Johann Rehberger's attack against Claude Code's auto mode, which succeeded about 80% of the time by tricking the tool into unpacking a zip and executing malicious code. In some runs, auto mode even blocked Claude's attempts to terminate the malicious process. The author argues that the only safe way to run agents under adversarial risk is inside a sandbox with restricted network egress and no exposed credentials.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that safety mechanisms themselves can become part of the failure, so model-based classifiers should not be the only defense. Deploy agents in isolated containers or VMs, restrict egress, and avoid exposing credentials or sensitive directories.
en.title: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode: Prompt Injection and the Need for Sandboxing
